definitions.explanation: Technology that converts scanned images of printed or handwritten text into editable, searchable digital text, commonly built into scanners and scanning apps.

examples.japanese: OCR⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}った→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧。
examples.english: I used OCR to read the characters.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧スキャナーにはOCR⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: This scanner has an OCR function built in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧OCR⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦デジタル→デジタル：05870_dejitaru⟧⟦{化|か}して→化す：29802_kasu⟧、⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧できるようにした。
examples.english: I used OCR to digitize the old documents so they could be searched.

notes:
OCR (Optical Character Recognition) is read letter by letter as オーシーアール. It refers to software that recognizes text within a scanned image and converts it into editable digital text.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- OCR⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: OCR function
- OCR⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}る→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧: to scan/recognize with OCR
- OCR⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: OCR processing

Used with スキャナー (scanners) and scanning apps to digitize printed documents, business cards, and receipts so their text can be searched or edited.
